hook: The number of uses needed to learn an unknown quantum process is now pinned down, with a matching lower bound.
summary: The authors settle how many queries to a quantum channel are needed to learn it to fixed accuracy in diamond distance, giving an algorithm and a matching lower bound. The method reduces channel learning to pure-state tomography of the Choi state. The optimality holds at constant accuracy, so scaling in the precision is not covered.
title: Optimal learning of quantum channels in diamond distance
